verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a telemetry timeline of "breadcrumbs" in rollbar.js, plus Apple Unified Logging capture as telemetry events. Person tracking ties users to each error and is automatic in Rails and Django. Nothing in the pack covers custom tags or arbitrary custom context on events. missing for 10: custom tags / arbitrary key-value context on events, breadcrumb support documented beyond client-side JS and Apple, how to attach user context on other SDKs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach breadcrumbs, custom tags, and user context to every event so a stack trace arrives with the state that produced it

citations.quote: The telemetry timeline provides a list of “breadcrumbs” events that can help developers understand and fix problems in their client-side javascript.
Rollbar can track which of your People (users) are affected by each error. This works automatically in our Rails and Django
allows capture of the AUL entries as corresponding Rollbar Telemetry log events.
